sources.title: Allianz H1 2026 results
sources.supports: Latest earnings, P&C ratios and solvency

sources.title: Allianz FY2025 results
sources.supports: Annual base, capital return and confounders

financial_anchor.caveat: Insurance-cycle, catastrophe and market effects require risk adjustment

ai_claim.claim: AI is used/planned in claims, underwriting and service, but public disclosure does not identify matched cohorts.
ai_claim.limitation: No denominator, controlled outcome or cash bridge

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Current combined-ratio improvement is explicitly explained by catastrophe and underwriting factors; restructuring/IT cost is elevated.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not disprove undisclosed task benefits

rights_limit: Policyholder, broker and licensed data are purpose- and contract-bound; operational access is not unrestricted pooled training permission.
materiality_summary: 5% of FY2025 operating profit is €868.7m; at FY2025 P&C volume, roughly 100 bps sustainable combined-ratio improvement would match it, before AI cost.

arithmetic.result: €868.7m or about 100 bps of P&C volume

g2_provisional: Not passed/limited: no controlled company-specific production economics.
unresolved_questions: What matched loss and expense outcomes result?
